messages.text: Hudson Valley Humira pend is stuck: office says the patient reacted to the biosimilar but still hasn't sent records. Anyone seen Bluepeak budge on these?

messages.text: FYI Bluepeak is auto-approving brand Humira now if the patient's been stable >6 months, just resubmit with a stability note from the rheum. Worked for me on 2 cases last week

messages.text: Bluepeak bounced my formulary exception because the biosimilar records just said 'intolerant'. They want the start and stop dates and what the reaction actually was.

messages.text: Tip for Northwind Dupixent step therapy: they accept triamcinolone 0.1% as a medium-potency steroid, but only if the chart lists the strength. Two of mine went through that way.
